priorFailureAndRecovery: The new application catalogue ingress initially exposed DocsSourceError beyond the selected native Worker initialisation contract. It now reports a fixed ConfigError at the owning host boundary; no unknown Schema detail escapes.

Direct native router tests initially treated request-decode failure as an already converted Response. The request host converts native Respondable failures; tests now exercise that conversion, and actual workerd independently proves the empty 400 response.

The dedicated Turbo task initially omitted PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH. The package command worked independently but the strict build environment could not render Mermaid. An actual Turbo dry result identified the missing environment admission; the corrected graph completes the real catalogue and native build. The first full verification then failed its isolated API-contract build because the parent quality-workflow test task also removed this setting. Both tasks now admit the same browser location; the failed full run took 520.62 seconds and retained 31 passing workflow tests.

Source consumers of the API Worker initially rejected its required JSON import attribute under ES2022. Only the API and its Website/infrastructure/Alchemy source-checking profiles use ESNext; public compiled package settings are preserved.

Extending standalone smoke exposed an outdated controlled HTTP fixture before the external consumer could start. The fixture now encodes the real checked content values, preserving failure/cleanup assertions and adding header/body deadline cases. All 85 API tests and actual standalone smoke pass.

The corrected full run passed all 32 real workflow tests, then Knip rejected the now-unused private in-process Promise adapter. It had no declared public export. The native replacement remains the published server-client entry; the retired file, exact production Promise permission and Knip allowance are removed. The actual strict accepted-file fixture now checks the native replacement, while the scoped Fetch-signature fixture remains.

Semantic owner review found that the accepted public Current routes list omitted the four newly added endpoints. The endpoint/error pages now explain those routes and replies. Two fresh hash-bound acceptance records replace only their active bindings; all prior records are retained. Broad API tests were insufficient evidence for narrative completeness, so the current receipt records direct review against the owning contracts and real replies.

The first two new review records were hashed before the formatter aligned their Markdown tables; check:docs rejected those stale source hashes. The records now identify the final formatted bytes and validation passes. The production graph also found that the Website content dependency was used only by native tests in this slice; it now belongs to devDependencies until Website source consumes it.

The first full verification passed in 611.42 seconds, including all 11 native pair cases. The subsequent repository tests exposed five SDK command-fixture failures: the expanded closure had moved the first build and a packed-command fixture relied on an eight-build offset. Core remains the first foundation build; the packing fixture now identifies the actual bun pm pack command and checks exact failed stage, exit code, safe error and cleanup. All 58 SDK tests, focused types/lint and the actual ten-artifact external consumer pass before final complete requalification.
